notes.title: New game "Era of Darkness" Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Happy New Year![/h2]

We are very happy to announce our new game, [b]Era of Darkness[/b], as our first news in 2024.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43885580/eaea6624533351fc580e2d8302b7276e18d344a1.png[/img]

Era of Darkness is a turn-based RPG that tells the story of people living in a world where the sun has lost its light and is overshadowed by darkness.

Using lessons from what we learned while developing the last game and feedback from the community, we are focusing on storytelling, character, and visual upgrades.

You can visit our store page now via the following.
Don't forget to add the game to your [b]wishlist[/b], too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2724330/Era_of_Darkness/

Era of Darkness supports English and Korean, and will be released as early access during the first quarter of this year.

We look forward to the day we present the game to you, and we will work on developing it.
Thank you.

- Karume
